An elderly couple wish their children to care for them in their old age. But their children see and treat them as a burden, and they must struggle to regain their worth and dignity.
Two thugs meet Rajiv, who belongs to a respectable family, and want to fix their sister's wedding with him. However, when Rajiv's uncle refuses to the match, a series of hilarious situations occur.
Criminals terrorize Mumbai while the weak police fail. A determined new DCP steps in, vowing to fight crime and restore safety to the city.
Shekhar falls for Roopa and visits her father with his family, but when his stepmother demands dowry, Roopa's father is insulted and decides to marry his daughter elsewhere, sparking conflict.
Balasaheb Thackeray, a cartoonist, quits after editor's disapproval, fights for Marathi rights, forms Shiv Sena, and seeks to become Maharashtra's Marathi Chief Minister someday.
While on a family trip to Shimla, Avinash falls in love with Naina who stays with her mother. However, things get complicated when Naina gives Avinash's love letter to her mother.
Business tycoon Raj Kumar abandons Shanti, his first love, to marry a rich heiress. Later, Vijay, Raj and Shanti's illegitimate son, seeks revenge from Raj for the injustice meted out to his mother.
Jai, a wealthy man, accidentally kills Tia's husband in a car accident. Wracked with guilt, he cares for her after she loses her memory, and fate leads her to fall in love with him.
Romeo, a small-time ruffian, joins drug lord Shivraj's gang but both fall in love with Chanda. Their rivalry turns violent as they fight for her love and power in the criminal world.
Priya falls for Rahul, who abandons her after pregnancy. Ostracised, she finds strength in Ajay, her best friend, who stands by her when everyone else walks away.
Ashfaque, a small-town dreamer turned Bollywood superstar, sees his glamorous life take a dark turn when he becomes the key witness in a shocking murder case that puts his fame and safety at risk.
